findings: Owner request 2026-10-29 (BOOK-EXERCISES-01): the chapter 2 exercise (PDF 51-53, printed 48-50) solved in English and Roman Urdu in Practice, like the Computer Science exercises: 9 MCQs (keyed checkpoints), 8 short answer, 5 constructed response, 8 comprehensive and 9 numerical problems. Every printed question is given in the book's words and order; answers are based on the chapter's lessons.
The book prints no MCQ key; every MCQ was worked out. Keys: 2.1 b, 2.2 d, 2.3 b, 2.4 c, 2.5 d, 2.6 c, 2.7 a, 2.8 a, 2.9 c.
Numerical problems are printed 2.1-2.4 and 2.6-2.10: number 2.5 is skipped in the book. They are kept with the printed numbers.

Book correction, numerical 2.6: the answers are printed (2.9 s, 41 m, 10.2 m) for (a) time of flight, (b) maximum height, (c) range; the maximum height is 10.2 m and the range 41 m (40.8 m), so the last two are swapped.
Book correction, numerical 2.8: the answer is printed as 60 N; the change in momentum is 240 N × 0.25 s = 60 N s (60 kg m s⁻¹).
Other printed answers checked and right: 2.1 60°, 2.2 8.0 s, 2.3 θ = 90°, 2.4 2.5 m s⁻¹, 2.7 25 N s, 2.9 8.08 km; 2.10 is a show-that.

Print slips not marked (no effect on the questions): the MCQ instruction is printed "Choose the corect answer" (written correctly here); the running heads of the exercise pages read "Chapter 3 Motion and Force" although this is chapter 2, Force and Motion.

Beyond the chapter: constructed response 2.3 (how birds fly) is not treated in the chapter; the answer uses Newton's third law and lift/drag and is labelled. Constructed response 2.4(iii) uses uniform circular motion, which the chapter does not describe (the projectile at its top is also mentioned in the answer).
